title: LG32-ASYM125-SHARP: complete exact raw two-term envelopes

claims.statement: For the single physical LG32-ASYM125-SHARP implementation and fixed exact configuration completely supplied in proof.md and virtual.md (finite exhaustive branch n<2^60; otherwise z=ceil(cuberoot(n)), w=floor(3249z²/10000), y=ceil(499z/5000), Hb=ceil(23378749z²/4990000),32 binary levels followed by y levels of32-input merges with the supplied counted physical bitcode and explicit full-b-bit root-record flags in MARK and classical append), for every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), full-secret success is unconditionally at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on EVERY branch time is O(n^136*2^((23378749/4990000)*n^(2/3)+(12311877/1247500)*n^(1/3))), ordinary classical space O(n), full quantum allocation O(n^88*2^((3249/10000)*n^(2/3)+(3249/5000)*n^(1/3))) and total acquisitions O(n^(19/6)*2^((499/1000)*n^(1/3))). All failures, rejected/discarded inputs, retries, caps, aborts, initialization, exact finite overflow repair, full addressing, source moves and output-first cleanup are included with absolute constants. The time upper-envelope index is exactly2/3.
